newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-MULLER SET FOR NATAL RETURN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-MULLER SET FOR NATAL RETURN.

text.p: Former Springbok centre Pieter Muller is set to return to the Natal side after two years of playing rugby league in Australia and rugby union for Toulouse.
Muller, who last wore Natal colours against England A at Durban's Kings Park in 1995, has been included in the Natal Super 12 squad to tour Australia and New Zealand from next weekend.

Although the strong-running centre has not yet been formally released by French club Toulouse, he was named in the Natal tour party announced on Saturday night after the South African province had beaten New South Wales 28-23 in a Super 12 match.

"Pieter is basically in the Natal squad, although we are still completing negotiations with Toulouse. We hope to have finalised all the details with them by this Monday," Natal Rugby Union president Keith Parkinson said.

"As matters stand, Pieter's contract with Toulouse expires at the end of May and obviously they would want some sort of compensation if he is to be released from it early," team director Craig Jameson explained.
He did not disclose what compensation Toulouse were seeking.

Muller, who switched back to rugby union with Toulouse after an injury-plagued sojourn with rugby league in Australia, established a reputation as a hard man during his 17 test appearances for South Africa.
